title: The skewer
line: A pin turned around: the bigger piece in front must move and the one behind falls.

steps.text: A skewer is a pin turned around. The king in front is in check and must move, and then the rook behind it can be taken.
Skewer the king and the rook: check on the line they share.

wrong.a1a5: That is check, but nothing stands behind the king on that line.

steps.hint: The king and the rook stand on the same column.
steps.after: The king must step off the e-file.
The rook behind the king falls.

steps.text: Bishops and queens skewer along diagonals too.
Check the king so that the rook on a8 stands behind it.
steps.hint: The king and the rook share a diagonal.

steps.after: The bishop took the rook from behind the king.

summary: A skewer attacks a big piece with a smaller one behind it on the same line. The front one moves, the back one falls.
